plan.title: Extend Submission Time Offered on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with no bids on its summary page.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where the Settings menu is available.
Assert the action is present and clickable while the RFQ is live.
Click the enabled Settings action to open its time-extension window.
Verify that clicking the action opens the increase-event-time window.
Cancel the dialog so no submission-time change is committed.
Confirm the time-extension window closed without saving.
